zh: 切点只有 n−1 个，左边是一个前缀、右边是对应的后缀，而右边的和等于总和减去左边的和。
先求出总和，再从左到右累加前缀和，就能在 O(1) 内判断每个切点是否满足“左边之和严格大于右边之和”。
前缀和依次加上第 1 个到第 n−1 个元素，每加一次就检查前缀和是否大于总和减去前缀和，满足就计数；n=1 时没有切点，答案为 0。元素可能为负，和可达 2·10^14，用 64 位整数。
en: There are only n-1 cut points; the left part is a prefix, the right part is the matching suffix, and the right sum equals the total minus the left sum.
Compute the total once and accumulate the prefix sum from left to right; then each cut point's condition, left sum strictly greater than right sum, is checked in O(1).

Add the 1st through (n-1)-th elements to the prefix sum one at a time, and after each addition count the cut if the prefix sum exceeds the total minus the prefix sum; for n = 1 there is no cut and the answer is 0. Elements may be negative and sums reach 2 * 10^14, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Accumulate the prefix sum and compare it with the total minus the prefix sum.

## Proof of correctness

For each valid cut point i, the left sum is exactly the prefix sum of the first i items and the right sum is exactly total-left; checking all n-1 cut points one by one, the count is the answer.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(1).

## Source notes

Integer sums use arbitrary precision; the standard input/output protocol and the upper bound on n are explicitly supplied by this site.

This site separately compiled the standard input/output protocol; it does not claim that the original site provided this protocol.
